The main takeaway from our work is that

the uniform rate region of a multiple access channel can be achieved by a single polar coding scheme, with fine enough resolution, by changing the decoding orders in the successive cancellation decoder.

the proposed L polar coding scheme is capable of achieving the whole uniform rate of the m-user multiple access channel with fine enough resolution, by simply changing the decoding order, without any change in the encoding process.

the proposed polar coding scheme achieves all the rates on the dominant rate region with fine resolution, and the rate region can be achieved with a constant gap from the optimal rate region as N and L grow large.
